title: Make the VIXEN build wrapper supply the paired Undertow root
body: The queued Release build initially stopped during CMake configure because UNDERTOW_ROOT was unset (libraries/Text/CMakeLists.txt requires it). Recovery required manually exporting UNDERTOW_ROOT=/home/liory/projects/undertow/.claude-worktrees/shadowedge alongside VIXEN_WITH_FSR3=OFF and VIXEN_FETCHCONTENT_CACHE before rerunning the documented build. Suggested consolidation: derive the paired Undertow worktree root from the VIXEN lane or make the wrapper validate and supply it.

title: Provision the WSL Vulkan loader environment for queued GPU captures
body: A direct queued look-dev GPU invocation without the shared Dozen ICD and LD_LIBRARY_PATH failed before rendering with VK_ERROR_INCOMPATIBLE_DRIVER/libxcb-keysyms.so.1 resolution errors. Recovery required manually setting VK_ICD_FILENAMES and LD_LIBRARY_PATH to the shared Dozen, X11, and Vulkan Loader cache paths. Suggested consolidation: have the canonical GPU capture test environment export these paths automatically.

title: Make the queued VIXEN build regenerate stale merged SDI headers
body: After the HitRecord layout source change, the queued Release build stopped at the SDI drift gate with seven stale merged headers and required the manual documented command: cd VIXEN && ../build/wsl/bin/sdi_tool merge-variants shaders/sdi-variants.json. The generated diff was valid and the next build passed. Suggested consolidation: make the normal queued build route perform or expose the source-checked regeneration step before the drift gate.

title: Repair the shadow-debug shader variant descriptor path
body: A minimal per-pixel shadow diagnostic using VIXEN_SHADOW_DBG_PX/VIXEN_SHADOW_DBG_PY failed before rendering in spatial_reuse_desc_gatherer with a missing descriptor layout followed by bad any_cast, while ordinary look-dev captures passed. Suggested consolidation: make the debug variant participate in the same generated descriptor-layout contract and fail with a scoped diagnostic instead of aborting the graph.
